phase: prediction, committed before any stream change
baseline: automation/runs/m2-s4/bench-stream-before.json (spreads 25% / 13%: the verdict uses before/after INTERLEAVED, before = a worktree of the commit carrying this file)

changes_and_claims.change: replayer: the hour key once per hour, one reused Avro buffer, no per-record dict copy
changes_and_claims.argument: Hour.key 0.60 s + ~0.4 s of buffer/copy overhead of ~6.3 s per hour = ~16%; bar 12%

changes_and_claims.change: lander: Arrow builds the landed table straight from the buffered records (no per-row dict comprehension)
changes_and_claims.argument: the comprehension is ~1.3-1.5 s of ~5.7 s per hour = 23-26%; bar 15%
produce + poll are ~0.5 s of 8.65 s; the producer is not the bottleneck, serialization is. Predicted not kept.

changes_and_claims.claim: every change: landed-file fingerprint and delivered/landed counts identical to before

keep_rule: a change is kept only if its claim holds on interleaved medians, its IQRs are disjoint from before (for R1, L1), and F1 holds; otherwise reverted
